```artifact
@startuml
actor Patient
actor Chemist
actor Lab
participant "Hospital Padmavathi Website" as HPW
participant "Web Browser" as WB
participant "Secure Connection" as SC
participant "Email Server" as ES

== TC-001: Patient Accesses the System via URL ==
Patient -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Patient: Display webpage

== TC-002: Chemist Accesses the System via URL ==
Chemist -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Chemist: Display webpage

== TC-003: Lab Accesses the System via URL ==
Lab -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Lab: Display webpage

== TC-004: Secure Connection for Patient ==
Patient -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Patient: Display webpage

== TC-005: Secure Connection for Chemist ==
Chemist -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Chemist: Display webpage

== TC-006: Secure Connection for Lab ==
Lab -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
HPW -> WB: Return webpage
WB -> Lab: Display webpage

== TC-007: Prescription and Invoice Sent via Email ==
Patient -> WB: Consultation completed
WB -> HPW: Notify consultation completion
HPW -> ES: Send Prescription and Invoice via email
ES -> Patient: Receive Prescription and Invoice via email

== TC-008: Failed Secure Connection for Patient ==
Patient -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
alt Connection fails
    SC -> WB: Connection failed
    WB -> Patient: Display error message
else Connection succeeds
    SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
    HPW -> WB: Return webpage
    WB -> Patient: Display webpage
end

== TC-009: Failed Secure Connection for Chemist ==
Chemist -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
alt Connection fails
    SC -> WB: Connection failed
    WB -> Chemist: Display error message
else Connection succeeds
    SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
    HPW -> WB: Return webpage
    WB -> Chemist: Display webpage
end

== TC-010: Failed Secure Connection for Lab ==
Lab -> WB: Open URL
WB -> HPW: Request access
WB -> SC: Establish secure connection (https://)
alt Connection fails
    SC -> WB: Connection failed
    WB -> Lab: Display error message
else Connection succeeds
    SC -> HPW: Secure connection established
    HPW -> WB: Return webpage
    WB -> Lab: Display webpage
end

@enduml
```
